title: Gate Remote Reactivation Charge on Restoring a Parking License
content:
**Gate reactivation charge** (Parking License restoration). Gate remotes stop working while privileges are suspended; restoring them carries a reactivation charge that depends on how many remotes the license holds.

**Remotes on the license.** The remotes on the license are the product's gate remotes issued at the start of the license plus the lost or additional remotes billed on the license — each gate remote fee line on the license counts as one remote.

**Charge.** When there are two or more remotes on the license, the gate reactivation charge accrues per remote, $7.50 for each remote on the license; when there is exactly one, the gate reactivation charge is a single flat $10.00; in every other case there is no gate reactivation charge. The gate reactivation charge is added to the reinstatement fee.

## Charge by remotes

| Remotes on the license | Gate reactivation charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | $10.00 (flat) |
| 2 | $15.00 ($7.50 for each of 2) |
| 3 | $22.50 ($7.50 for each of 3) |

## Illustrations (hypothetical licenses)

- A product issuing 1 remote at start, with no remote fee line on the license: 1 remote, $10.00.
- The same product with one lost-remote fee line billed: 2 remotes, $15.00.
- A product issuing 2 remotes at start, with one additional remote billed: 3 remotes, $22.50.
- A product issuing no remotes, with no remote fee line: no charge.
